open_points.subject: release dependency declaration and admission evidence
open_points.text: they make the release, name its dependencies and install them
open_points.question: How will factory checks construct and verify the complete dependency declaration, including transitive packages, Python and the base image, before admitting a release?
options: Generate a locked dependency manifest from the resolved build and compare it with the packaged runtime inventory.
Treat a fully pinned manifest as the build input and reject any produced artifact whose runtime inventory differs.
consequences: Inventory-first checking detects undeclared resolved dependencies but requires deterministic inspection of every runtime artifact.
Manifest-first construction makes the declaration authoritative but requires the build to prove that no additional runtime dependency entered the artifact.
open_points.requirement: A release names every dependency it runs with, at an exact version, with its digest: every Python package, direct or transitive, by the digest of its distribution file; the Python version; and the base image of VM Platform's Registry environment by its digest, which fixes the system libraries and the store's engine.
open_points.default_guess: Use a fully pinned manifest as the build input, then compare the packaged runtime inventory against it before release admission.

open_points.subject: installation enforcement of the admitted dependency set
open_points.text: Rules 1–4 are kept by the release process and its installation
open_points.question: How will deployment ensure that an installed and running instance contains exactly the admitted dependencies and cannot substitute or add runtime code?
options: Install every artifact from a digest-verified locked set into an isolated runtime and verify the resulting inventory before start.
Deploy an immutable prebuilt image selected by digest and prohibit installation or code loading after image construction.
consequences: Verified installation supports rebuilding environments but needs a reliable post-install inventory and a start gate.
An immutable image reduces installation-time variation but makes image construction and digest verification the sole enforcement boundary.
open_points.requirement: A running instance uses exactly those; installing a dependency whose digest differs fails.
open_points.default_guess: Deploy an immutable image by digest and admit startup only after verifying that the image and its recorded runtime inventory match the release declaration.
